02The artist

More than

MUSIC.

Lyfe Jennings makes songs that tell the truth before they offer the answer.

A singer, songwriter and storyteller, Lyfe built a catalog around love, accountability, consequence, faith and becoming. His work speaks plainly, carries soul, and keeps finding new listeners because the stories remain human.

More than two decades after Lyfe 268-192, he remains an active recording and touring artist—meeting a multigenerational audience in the place where testimony and music become one.
